binds.source: CSZ Paper II, Section 2, axioms on Y0

issue: The prereg proof-obligation labels called connected-seed 'base_i' and no-outside-complete-to-seed 'base_ii'. Source-exact CSZ numbering instead has (i) G\X0 connected; (ii) S connected AND no vertex outside S complete to S; (iii) canonical Y0; (iv) no mixing on a Y0 edge.

source_exact_axioms.ii: S is connected and no vertex in V(G) minus S is complete to S.
source_exact_axioms.iii: Y0 = V(G) minus (N(S) union X0 union S).
source_exact_axioms.iv: No vertex in V(G) minus (Y0 union X0) is mixed on an edge of Y0.

repair.i: Add the omitted explicit obligation: forcing changes neither G nor X0, so G minus X0 remains connected.
repair.ii: Treat connectedness of the enlarged seed and the no-outside-complete clause jointly as source axiom (ii).
repair.iii: Keep the prereg canonical-residual obligation unchanged.
repair.iv: Keep the prereg no-mixing obligation unchanged.

scope_effect: NONE. The gate remains one-step source-bound base closure only. No new theorem target, solver, recursion, polynomiality, class-return, or C5C claim is introduced.
prereg_integrity: The original prereg is immutable; all B2B0 result/replay/seal artifacts must bind both the original prereg blob and this repair blob.
